items.title: Ruma Latte first-birthday matcha event
items.description: Ruma Latte, the Tustin matcha vendor, celebrates its first birthday at the Old Town Tustin Farmers Market. The post asks guests to RSVP in advance to reserve a spot.
items.notes: Search snippet of an Instagram post: 'RUMA LATTE IS TURNING ONE IN DECEMBER ... December 5, 2026, 10 AM-12 PM, Old Town Tustin Farmers Market, RSVP to participate'. Unclear whether it is a walk-up stand or an RSVP-only activity; no street address in snippet. Brand already in data/wave4/socal.json (inactive, handle unverified).

items.title: Kaphé Muna coffee and matcha pop-up at Golden Makers Market
items.description: Kaphé Muna, a Filipino-heritage specialty coffee and matcha pop-up, is a named vendor among 45+ makers at the Golden Makers holiday market in Point Loma. Free RSVP through the market.
items.notes: Golden Guide post (Nov 19 2026) names Kaphé Muna as a vendor at the Dec 6 market at Brick 828, Point Loma; market page post gives Sunday Dec 6 12-5pm. No street address found; the vendor's own hours at the market not stated. Market itself is in the earlier sweep as unsure.
